👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Today on the Indian Business podcast we have Flying Beast aka Gaurav Taneja turned his passion for fitness into BeastLife a ₹30 crore protein brand built not just on performance, but on trust.
In a market flooded with mistrust and misinformation, Gaurav is leading with transparency, targeting real Indian needs, and proving that credibility still wins in business.
In this podcast, we go beyond the content and into the mind of a creator-turned-founder how he spotted the gap, built a tribe, and launched a product that’s shaking up an industry.
